The California Department of General Services (DGS) is hiring an IT Specialist I as a .NET Developer – Security Specialist in Enterprise Technology Solutions. The role participates in all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle and completes software and documentation deliverables.
Healthcare
Dental
Health Care
Medical
Mental Health
No H1B
Responsibilities
Under direction of the Information Technology (IT) Supervisor II, the IT Specialist I in the Department of General Services, Enterprise Technology solutions in the Custom Application Solutions section, within the Software Engineering domain, will participate in all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle and be responsible for completion of software and documentation deliverables
Qualification
C#
.NET MVC and Web API
Angular and TypeScript
T-SQL
SQL Server stored procedures and query optimization
SSRS reporting
JavaScript and jQuery
HTML5 and CSS3
RxJS
LINQ
REST API integration
Active Directory Windows Authentication
Required
The successful candidate must reside in California upon appointment
Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship by the start date of employment
Proficient in C#, T-SQL, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, component architecture, services, routing, and RxJS
Experience with .NET MVC, Web API, building responsive UIs and cross-browser compatible layouts
Strong skills in writing stored procedures, views, and functions, REST API integration using Angular's HttpClient, and with Reactive Forms and Template-driven Forms
Strong experience with Angular (v2+) using TypeScript, optimize queries, using indexes, and joins
Experience with Windows Authentication using Active Directory, using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), designing and deploying SSRS report
Strong knowledge of LINQ (Language Integrated Query), HTTP methods, CORS, cookies, and status codes
Understanding of OOP (Object-Oriented Programming) principles, relational schema design and data normalization, report datasets, RDL file structure, Report Builder
Familiarity with .NET Framework, integrating SSRS reports, Angular CLI, npm, UI frameworks
Ability to create parameterized, drill-down, and linked reports, troubleshoot and optimize report performance
Benefits
Hybrid telework up to five (5) days a week, with reporting to the office as needed/required
